name: Heaven’s Gate
storyline: The year is 2409. The Mojave is no longer the wasteland you once knew. Centuries ago, Courier 6 seized the Strip, unleashed the Glow according to him, and reshaped Nevada into a world of radiation, mutants, and fractured faith. You are the follower who must walk this new land. You will uncover forgotten vaults, confront the remnants of the Enclave, meet survivors who cling to myths, and ultimately face Courier 6 himself - now a figure of power, pride, and corruption. The question is not only whether you can survive... But whether you can resist.
summary: Heaven's Gate is a story-driven overhaul of Fallout: New Vegas that reimagines the Mojave as a mythic, spiritually charged wasteland shaped by the Glow. Explore a reworked world with altered landscapes and haunting atmospheres while uncovering new lore about twisted urban legends and the Courier's dark reign. Every major character features around 3000 fully voiced lines, and branching dialogues explore themes of faith, rebellion, and redemption with philosophical depth. Encounter new enemies, allies, and factions born from the Glow's influence as you navigate a darker, more meaningful New Vegas experience that integrates the base game and all DLC content.
